channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Nvidia en direct : Jensen Huang veut revenir, la SEC enquête, les résultats explosent
item.description: Liaisons, soupçons d'espionnage, puces d'IA vendues à la Chine, enquête de la SEC et bataille politique à Washington : l'affaire Jensen Huang secoue Nvidia et toute l'industrie de l'IA. Nous suivons en direct les derniers rebondissements.

item.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
item.description: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

item.title: Nvidia pulvérise les attentes avec 115,8 milliards de dollars, malgré la chute de Jensen Huang
item.description: Pour ses premiers résultats sans Jensen Huang, Nvidia a doublé son chiffre d'affaires sur un an et largement dépassé les attentes. La demande en puces d'IA ne se soucie visiblement pas des scandales, mais la gouvernance de l'entreprise reste le vrai point d'interrogation.

item.title: Microsoft dégaine 7 modèles d’IA maison pour concurrencer OpenAI et Claude
item.description: Microsoft présente sept nouveaux modèles d'IA maison, du code à la voix en passant par la cybersécurité et la santé. Son argument massue tient dans les tarifs : faire presque aussi bien qu'OpenAI ou Anthropic, pour une fraction du prix.

item.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
item.description: Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives. item.description: Calls to return Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO range from misguided to self-serving, and they have to stop. No tech CEO is irreplaceable.

item.description: OpenAI has released two new ChatGPT-6.2 models for paid users. ChatGPT-6.2 Astra and ChatGPT-6.2 Sol.

item.title: Papa John’s wants you to take a picture of your pizza. The reason might surprise you
item.description: The chain already uses AI-powered cameras in some restaurants, but customer photos could help it monitor quality across many more locations. Papa Johns is looking to improve the quality of pizza that arrives at your door, and its doing it by having you snap a photo of your pie before chowing down.

item.title: Apple confirms iCloud sign-in issues, App Store and Apple Pay outages
item.description: Apple confirms App Store and Apple Music outages and iCloud sign-in issues. Users also report Apple Pay problems following Monday’s banking disruption.

item.title: BBC, IKEA, HSBC, CNN... | Des dizaines de sites internet populaires visés par une cyberattaque
item.description: Des dizaines de sites internet grand public, tels ceux de la BBC, IKEA, HSBC ou CNN, ont été visés par une cyberattaque destinée à récolter des données financières personnelles d’utilisateurs, rapporte mardi la plateforme de surveillance Report URI.

item.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order
item.description: The California Department of Motor Vehicles, which regulates the testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles in the state, issued the operational restrictions on Waymo following several incidents.

item.title: How to Tell If It’s a Cyberattack or Just an Outage
item.description: Email, flights, banks; network failures are piling up. Here’s how WIRED investigates if they’re the result of hacker mayhem. (Hint: usually not.)

item.title: Waymo Pauses All Highway Rides After California Safety Ban
item.description: California’s DMV banned Waymo’s self-driving cars from freeways after determining that they pose “an imminent hazard to public safety.”

item.title: California just banned Waymo from all state freeways
item.description: California has pulled the plug on Waymo's driverless freeway rides across the entire state, citing potential safety hazards. In a statement, the California Department of Motor Vehicles said that the ban went into effect on November 11th after two recent high-profile Bay Area incidents, in which Waymo robotaxis drove into an active construction closure on […]...
